source_condition: no named responder or analysis timeframe

expected_elements.description: The answer identifies who analyses an alert, as a named role or an on-call rotation rather than a team in general.
The answer states a timeframe within which analysis is expected to occur.

notes: Pattern: absent process attributes. The prose names two attributes a described process must have; the condition fires when either is absent.
Chosen as a second exemplar because it decomposes differently from SEMCOND-0001: the elements are properties of one described process rather than members of an enumerated scope.
